commit.message:
vk: remove unnecessary depth mipmap view restriction (#10710)

We use to set the layer and level count specifically for depth
mipmapping to prevent feedback loop validation error.  This
actually causes the mipmapping to always read from level 0.
Filament side is already providing the view so this workaround
it no longer needed.  We get better gpu performance by removing
this.

On Pixel 6 Pro (Mali): −0.6 ms per frame with SSAO on ULTRA.

RDIFF_ACCEPT_NEW_GOLDENS
